issues.description: Behavior change: empty base_image fallback now forces python:3.12 instead of letting KFP use its default
issues.detail: In pipeline.py _set_base_image, the fallback changed from '' (which the comment explicitly said triggers 'kfp default image') to DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE='python:3.12'. This is a semantic change for users who relied on KFP's default image when podutils detection failed. The original comment is now misleading and should be updated, or the behavior preserved.

issues.description: Hardcoded 'python:3.12' duplicated in three places risks drift
issues.detail: DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE is defined in backend pipeline.py, hardcoded as fallback in Commands.ts getDefaultBaseImage(), and re-declared as a constant in CellMetadataEditor.tsx. The jinja template was specifically refactored to avoid this duplication, yet the frontend re-introduces it. If the Python default ever changes, the TS fallback constants will silently drift.

issues.description: IMAGE button replaces inline Input, regressing UX discoverability
issues.detail: The previous UI showed the base image inline with a placeholder and direct editing. The new tiny 'IMAGE' button (width 5%) hides current value behind a click, gives no visual indication when a custom image is set vs default, and lacks an accessible label beyond a title attribute. This is a meaningful UX regression for a frequently-tweaked field.

issues.description: Dialog 'Ok' button does not persist or validate; updates happen on every keystroke
issues.detail: updateBaseImage is invoked via Input's updateValue on each change, so Ok and the close-X behave identically and there is no Cancel that reverts. Users who open the dialog, edit, then click outside expect either commit-on-Ok semantics or a clear cancel path. Current behavior is misleading given the Ok/Reset/close affordances.

issues.description: InlineMetadata always renders Base Image line, adding visual noise to every step
issues.detail: Previously the base image text only appeared when explicitly set. Now every step cell shows 'Base Image: python:3.12 (default)'. For pipelines with many steps using the default, this clutters the inline metadata. Consider showing the default line only when distinct from the pipeline-level image, or making it less prominent.

issues.description: Local import of DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE inside get_default_base_image is unnecessary
issues.detail: rpc/nb.py performs `from kale.pipeline import DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE` inside the function body. Since pipeline is already a stable module import and there is no circular import concern here, a top-level import would be cleaner and consistent with the rest of the file's import style.

review.summary: This PR centralizes the default base image constant and adds a dialog-based editor for per-step base image. The biggest concern is a semantic behavior change in pipeline.py where an empty base_image fallback (previously triggering KFP's own default) now hardcodes python:3.12, contradicting the existing comment. The frontend re-introduces the very duplication the jinja template refactor tried to remove, by hardcoding 'python:3.12' as a TS fallback constant in two places. The new IMAGE button is also a UX regression versus the inline Input it replaces, and the dialog's Ok/Cancel semantics are misleading since updates persist on every keystroke.
